payload.title: M3: Every published Story gets a star suggestion that feeds announcements (MoM)
payload.description:
**Tasks:** PPY-924693 (suggest on publish and on Reference accept); PPY-89f253 (agreement report; drop its dependency on PPY-994ff6).

**Exit test (on MoM):** Ryan publishes a Story; a suggestion appears within the quiet window and joins the day's one review; confirming a five-star candidate produces an X draft with no other action; papyrus reports agreement by section. Closes epic PPY-24b2ac.
